mapper.update: UPDATE t_app_config SET config_value = #{configValue}, value_type = #{valueType}, config_name = #{configName}, remark = #{remark}, deleted = 0, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND deleted = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_app_config (config_key, config_value, value_type, config_name, remark) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{valueType}, #{configName}, #{remark}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), value_type = VALUES(value_type), config_name = VALUES(config_name), remark = VALUES(remark), deleted = 0, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
